name: Nightstand
pitch: A drawer-and-shelf nightstand that fits on a single 4x8 sheet, stands on its own feet so the robot vacuum goes underneath, and converts to a wall-hung French-cleat piece.

stages.title: Cut the sheet
stages.detail: Cut the fit-test coupon first (slot = tab + 0.1 mm), then the sheet from the DXF (CUT layer): 26 m of path. Cut small holes and slots first, outlines last; air assist on.

stages.title: Remove char and sand
stages.detail: Brush the char off every cut edge, then 120 and 180 grit. Ease the top edges by hand. Sand the drawer pull slot.

stages.title: Dry fit
stages.detail: Stand SIDE-L and SIDE-R, push in the SHELF and BACK tabs, then the TOP. Check every tab is flush and the carcass is square. No glue yet.

stages.title: Pre-finish
stages.detail: Stain or seal every face now (oil or poly). Mask the tabs and slots so the glue bonds to bare wood.

stages.title: Drawer box
stages.detail: Glue the finger-jointed DRW-SIDE/FRONT/BACK corners, drop in DRW-BOTTOM through its side tabs, and drive the 8 corner and bottom screws (3.0 mm pilots are pre-cut). Check for square.

stages.title: Glue-up (Titebond III)
stages.detail: Glue the SHELF and BACK into SIDE-L, add SIDE-R, then set the TOP over all four side tabs. Clamp across the width; wipe squeeze-out.

stages.title: Screws as clamps
stages.detail: 30 #8 screws in all: #8 x 1-1/2 in through the side faces into the shelf, back and top edges (hidden at the sides, heads on top get filled); #8 x 1-1/4 in for the drawer runners and face. Pilots are laser-cut.

stages.title: Runners and drawer face
stages.detail: Screw the two RUNNERs to the inside of the sides from the outside, drop the drawer on them, then fix DRW-FACE with a 1.5 mm reveal from inside the drawer front.

stages.title: Optional French cleat
stages.detail: For a wall-hung version: glue CLEAT-BACKER-A and -B to the rear face of BACK (before the drawer goes in), screw an aluminum Z-bar to layer B, and put the wall half into two studs. Skip for floor standing.

stages.title: Finish and pack
stages.detail: Final coat, 24 h cure, felt dots under the 4 feet, flat-pack the drawer parts with the carcass in one box.

materials.sheet: 18 mm (3/4 in) sanded plywood (basic birch-faced or cabinet ply), 4 x 8 ft x 1

hardware.note: optional wall-mount version (seller-claimed 150 lb per pair)

materials.finish: wipe-on poly or hardwax oil, 2 coats (about $8)

safety: Not a tall piece: no wall anchor is required, but if the cleat version is used, both wall-half screws must land in studs.
Drawer has no stop or soft-close: the box can pull out fully. Fit a drawer stop if used with children.
Wall-hung load: keep contents under 10 kg. Seller-claimed cleat rating is not verified.
Not a children's product (no CPSIA testing).
